title: CoLink: Global Compression and Knowledge Linking for Multi-Turn Dialogue Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.34335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extracting salient information from long-horizon dialogue histories remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to the restricted context windows and efficient retrieval challenges. Current methods typically rely on history organization or local token-level optimization, suffering from information loss, retrieval redundancy, and myopic attention. Inspired by the view in cognitive science that dialogue constitutes sense-making and memory association, we propose CoLink, a framework that enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues through information linking and compression. CoLink first clusters historical contexts into topic graphs to establish cross-semantic associations with external knowledge. translated_title: CoLink：面向多轮对话建模的全局压缩与知识链接
translated_abstract: 受限于受限的上下文窗口和高效检索的挑战，从长程对话历史中提取显著信息对大型语言模型（LLMs）而言仍是一项重大难题。当前方法通常依赖于历史组织或局部token级优化，存在信息丢失、检索冗余和短视注意力等问题。受认知科学中“对话构成意义建构与记忆联想”这一观点的启发，我们提出了CoLink，这是一个通过信息链接与压缩来增强LLMs在领域特定多轮对话中全局上下文感知能力的框架。CoLink首先将历史上下文聚类为主题图，以建立与外部知识的跨语义关联；随后在思维自适应控制（adaptive control of thought）的指导下，通过协同语义相关性与图结构拓扑来检索并激活知识。至关重要的是，为了实现有效的……
tldr: 提出CoLink框架，通过将对话历史聚类为主题图并协同语义相关性与图结构拓扑进行知识检索激活，实现信息链接与全局压缩，从而增强LLM在领域特定多轮对话中的全局上下文感知能力。
en_tdlr: CoLink enhances LLMs' global context awareness in domain-specific multi-turn dialogues by clustering dialogue histories into topic graphs and retrieving knowledge via synergizing semantic relevance and graph-structural topology, achieving information linking and global compression.
